<!-- Code generated by packages/kit-compose/src/organisms.ts from packages/compose-gen/specs (compose-gen organism emitters on kit-compose). DO NOT EDIT. -->
<!--
  The head of a section: an optional badge, the heading (h1 or h2) with an optional link opposite it, and an
  optional lead. No wrapper: its parts are children of the section stack.
-->
<script lang="ts">
import type { SectionHeading, HeadLink } from "./section-frame.types";

export type SectionHeaderProps = {
  titleId: string;
  title?: string;
  heading?: SectionHeading;
  action?: HeadLink;
  lead?: string;
  center?: boolean;
};
</script>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed } from "vue";
import Badge from "../compose/Badge.vue";
import Group from "../compose/Group.vue";
import Link from "../compose/Link.vue";
import Text from "../compose/Text.vue";
import Title from "../compose/Title.vue";
import { defaults } from "../presets/defaults";
import { cn, urlOf } from "../utils";

const { titleId, title = "", heading, action, lead, center = false } = defineProps<SectionHeaderProps>();
const level = computed(() => heading?.level ?? 2);
const scale = computed(() => heading?.scale ?? "default");
const hasAction = computed(() => action?.label && action?.href);
</script>

<template>
  <Badge
    v-if="heading?.badge"
    variant="outline"
    size="lg"
    :class="(center ? 'mx-auto w-fit' : 'w-fit')"
    data-testid="section-badge"
  >
    {{ heading?.badge }}
  </Badge>
  <Group
    v-if="(((title as string) !== '') && hasAction)"
    gap="4"
    align="center"
    justify="between"
    class="w-full flex-wrap"
  >
    <Title
      :as="level"
      :size="((level === 1) ? '5xl' : 'xl')"
      weight="semibold"
      :class="
        (scale as string) === 'display' ? 'text-6xl tracking-tight md:text-8xl'
        : level === 1 ? 'leading-tight'
        : 'leading-7'
      "
      :id="titleId"
    >
      {{ title }}
    </Title>
    <Link
      :href="urlOf(action?.href)"
      variant="default"
      :class="cn(defaults.text.tiny, 'shrink-0 font-medium leading-5')"
      data-testid="section-action"
    >
      {{ action?.label }}
    </Link>
  </Group>
  <Title v-if="(((title as string) !== '') && !hasAction)"
    :as="level"
    :size="((level === 1) ? '5xl' : 'xl')"
    weight="semibold"
    :class="
      (scale as string) === 'display' ? 'text-6xl tracking-tight md:text-8xl'
      : level === 1 ? 'leading-tight'
      : 'leading-7'
    "
    :id="titleId"
  >
    {{ title }}
  </Title>
  <Group v-if="(((title as string) === '') && hasAction)" gap="4" align="center" justify="end" class="w-full">
    <Link
      :href="urlOf(action?.href)"
      variant="default"
      :class="cn(defaults.text.tiny, 'shrink-0 font-medium leading-5')"
      data-testid="section-action"
    >
      {{ action?.label }}
    </Link>
  </Group>
  <Text v-if="lead" size="base" :class="cn('max-w-2xl text-muted-foreground', (center ? 'mx-auto' : ''))">
    {{ lead }}
  </Text>
</template>
